//: CORS for the Firebase Storage bucket.
//1: Lottie animations are fetched with XHR by the CRM's preview and by
//2: lottie-web, and a browser refuses a cross-origin fetch unless the bucket
//3: says otherwise. A brand-new bucket has NO cors policy, which is why every
//4: animation went blank with 'CORS blocked' immediately after the migration —
//5: the files are there and readable, the browser just will not hand them to
//6: the page. and the Android app are unaffected, so thumbnails kept
//7: working and only the lotties broke, which makes it look like a data
//8: problem rather than a bucket setting.
//9: Apply with: gsutil cors set storage-cors.json gs://zipper-83816.firebasestorage.app
//10: GET and HEAD only. These are read-only asset fetches; uploads go through
//11: the Firebase SDK, which does not need a CORS entry.
//12: Range headers matter: lottie-web and the video/audio elements issue range
//13: requests for the larger files, and without these exposed the response is
//14: opaque to the page even though it arrived.
